But in-game, the Level 3 '''Hunter''' inaccurately bolts it anyways. *Even though the M1 Garand is a semi-automatic rifle in real life, the original '''Hunter''' would pull back a bolt manually, which is historically inaccurate as the M1 Garand does not have one. **The M1 Garand is also an infantry rifle, meaning it is not made for hunting. *The original Level 5 Default knife that is sheathed was the [[w:c:r2da:Restricted Access|Restricted Access]] [[w:c:r2da:Rambo Knife|Rambo Knife]] that BelowNatural made for ''R2DA''. **The original Level 5 {{Color|Other|Halloween}} knife was the [[w:c:r2da:Halloween (Skin)|Halloween]] [[w:c:r2da:Rambo Knife|Rambo Knife]] from ''R2DA''. *The chainsaw on the back of the original Level 5 {{Color|Other|Halloween}} skin is the [[w:c:r2da:Chainsaw|Chainsaw]] used in ''R2D'' and ''R2DA''. *For the original {{Color|Other|Halloween}} skin, the Falcon was replaced by the [[Bat (Nightmare Carnival)|Bat]], the same one that appears in [[Nightmare Carnival]]. *Despite being released at Halloween, along with other [[Halloween 2019 Crate]] skins, the {{Color|Other|Halloween}} skin is not considered to be a Halloween skin, but rather a coded skin. **The {{Color|Other|Halloween}} skin was the first skin to be released exclusively as a code. *The original {{Color|Basic|Blue}} skin looked similar to the original design of the '''Hunter''' when it was planned to be called the ''Clout God''. **This accessory was added way after the '''Hunter''' was added. *The Level 3+ {{Color|Eclipse|Vampire Slayer}} skin will look through its scope with its right eye despite having an eyepatch. *The {{Color|Scuba|Scuba Ops}} skin was made by Linx.https://x.com/LinxtheDev/status/2073078053920489822 ===Roblox Catalog=== *The
